title: Surreal Vintage Collage (DALL-E)
description: Surrealist mixed-media collage using vintage imagery. Popular for art prints, music album covers, and avant-garde fashion content.

prompt.main: A surrealist mixed-media collage on aged paper, featuring a giant hand holding a tiny vintage city, floating clouds cut from old encyclopedia pages, classical sculpture faces combined with modern skyscrapers, dreamy impossible composition, romantic poet style with cut-and-paste edges

explained.why: Vivid style brings out the surreal color contrast.

tutorial.intro: DALL-E 3 + Vivid + "surrealist collage" + "aged paper" = automatic art school aesthetic. DALL-E handles the cut-and-paste feel well.
steps: Format: A surrealist mixed-media collage on aged paper 鈥?format + surface.
Subject 1: giant hand holding a tiny vintage city 鈥?scale contrast.
Subject 2: floating clouds cut from old encyclopedia pages 鈥?mixed media source.
Subject 3: classical sculpture faces combined with modern skyscrapers 鈥?historical + modern contrast.
Composition: dreamy impossible composition, romantic poet style with cut-and-paste edges 鈥?style + edge treatment.
tutorial.tips: Collage = scale contrast + mixed sources + visible cut edges. DALL-E Vivid style brings this out naturally.

crossModel.midjourney: MJ v6.1: "surrealist collage, hand holding city, encyclopedia --ar 1:1 --v 6.1 --s 850".
crossModel.flux: Flux is OK. MJ often best for collage.

faq.q: Why does my collage look digital?
faq.a: You forgot "cut-and-paste edges" + "aged paper" + specific mixed sources (encyclopedia pages).
1:1 with high contrast. Prints well at 16x20" or larger for art prints.

faq.q: How to make it feel handmade?
faq.a: Name the source materials (encyclopedia, vintage photos, classical art). DALL-E renders the cut edges.
